name: screenshot-camera
description: Captures a screenshot from a Unity camera.

cameraPath.description: Hierarchy path to Camera GameObject. Use indexed path from hierarchy/find for duplicate names.

cameraInstanceId.description: Camera GameObject or Camera component instanceId. Use with cameraPath when name/path is ambiguous.

cameraName.description: Legacy name fallback when path/id omitted.

savePath.description: Optional path to also write the resulting PNG to disk. Accepts an absolute path (e.g. C:/Shots/cam.png) or a path relative to the Unity project folder (e.g. ./Temp/cam.png). Parent folders are created as needed.
